# ImgSplit

> Free online image tools — split, grid, resize, compress, watermark, and more. 100% browser-based image processing; your images never leave your device.

## What is ImgSplit?

ImgSplit (imgsplit.com) is a free, privacy-first online image toolkit. All image processing runs locally in your browser using the HTML5 Canvas API — no uploads, no server-side image handling. Drag split lines to cut images with pixel-perfect precision, create social media grids, resize, compress, add watermarks, and more.

## Core Features

- Manual drag-and-drop split lines with snap alignment (up to 20 horizontal + 20 vertical lines)
- Grid splitting (3×3, 1×3, 2×2) for social media posts
- Carousel splitting for wide images
- Image resize, crop, rotate, and export
- Compress and convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP
- Text and logo watermarks
- Privacy mask (mosaic, blur, solid cover)
- Photo collage layouts
- Social media size export (multi-platform ZIP)
- Local AI background removal (runs in browser Web Worker; model downloaded once, images never uploaded)
- Pixel-perfect precision with zero quality loss on crops
- Supports PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP up to 20MB
- One-click ZIP download
- Works on desktop and mobile

## Tools

- [Image Splitter](https://imgsplit.com/): Full-featured splitter with custom drag-and-drop split lines
- [Grid Splitter](https://imgsplit.com/grid): Split images into grid tiles for Instagram and social media
- [Carousel Splitter](https://imgsplit.com/carousel): Split wide images into carousel slides
- [Image Resizer](https://imgsplit.com/resize): Resize, crop, rotate, and export to any dimension
- [Image Compressor](https://imgsplit.com/compress): Compress and convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP
- [Watermark Tool](https://imgsplit.com/watermark): Add text or logo watermarks with opacity control
- [Privacy Mask](https://imgsplit.com/mosaic): Hide faces, license plates, and sensitive areas
- [Photo Collage](https://imgsplit.com/collage): Combine multiple photos into grid and story layouts
- [Social Export](https://imgsplit.com/social-export): Export one image to multiple platform-ready sizes
- [AI Background Remover](https://imgsplit.com/remove-background): Remove backgrounds locally in the browser
- [All Tools](https://imgsplit.com/tools): Browse all image tools
- [About](https://imgsplit.com/about): About ImgSplit and the team

## Languages

Available in English, 中文 (Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese), 한국어 (Korean), Español (Spanish), and Português (Brazilian Portuguese) — 6 languages total.

## Key Facts

- Price: Free (no signup required)
- Privacy: All image processing happens in your browser — images are never uploaded. We use anonymous product analytics (self-hosted Umami) and error monitoring (Sentry); no advertising cookies, no personal identity tracking.
- Limits: Up to 20 horizontal + 20 vertical split lines per image
- File size: Up to 20MB per image
- Formats: PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP
